s.h: We're looking for a Business Development Lead.
s.t:
This is a role for someone who loves generating pipeline but also enjoys figuring out better ways to generate it.
You'll spend much of your time building relationships with prospective customers and creating opportunities for our Account Executives. But unlike a traditional BDR role, you'll also own the evolution of our outbound motion.
You'll experiment with AI-powered prospecting workflows, evaluate new tools, improve our messaging, optimise our processes and help define what modern outbound looks like at Ballpark.
You'll have a genuine opportunity to influence how we generate revenue as we continue to scale.

Generate qualified pipeline through thoughtful outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone and any other channels that create meaningful conversations
Own prospecting strategy across target accounts, personas and industries
Design and continuously improve AI-assisted outbound workflows to help us scale intelligently
Evaluate new sales and AI tooling that gives Ballpark a competitive advantage
Refine messaging, sequences and outreach playbooks through constant experimentation
Share learnings across the team and help build the outbound playbook for future hires
Stay ahead of emerging AI and GTM trends, bringing new ideas back into the business

Previous outbound SaaS business development experience
A consistent track record of generating high-quality pipeline
Someone who enjoys building systems and improving processes, not just following them
Genuine curiosity around AI and excitement about applying new technology to sales
Strong written communication and an ability to personalise outreach at scale
Highly organised, proactive and commercially minded
Collaborative, humble and happy to share what's working with the wider team
Bonus points if you've sold into product, design, UX or research teams.
Note: We love AI at Ballpark but find it's not the best for producing cover letters that make a good first impression. Try to avoid automating your cover letter.

Position Summary: EASI is BoxPower 's cloud platform for modeling, pricing, and designing solar + storage microgrid projects — turning work that took weeks into minutes. Since its public beta launch in March 2026, external users have modeled $100M+ in project value on the platform.

EASI has strong top-of-funnel growth; this role's job is to turn users into active, successful users — and channel partners into a repeatable pipeline.

The Product & Business Development Associate is the face of EASI to developers, ESCOs, and utility partners: onboarding them, teaching them what's possible, publishing content that shows how, and demoing the platform at industry events.

Internally, they translate what they hear into roadmap input and go-to-market plans alongside the Director of Software Products. This is a high-ownership role for an early-career energy generalist who can hold their own in both a technical modeling conversation and a partner pitch. Roughly 75% business development and growth, 25% product management.

Key Responsibilities: Business development & partner enablement (~40%) Own onboarding and ongoing support for EASI channel partners (ESCOs, developers, EPCs, co-ops) — from NDA to first modeled project to portfolio adoption.

Run product demos: live at conferences and meetups, and scheduled deep-dives with prospective partners; drive on-the-spot signups. Support the sales team in using EASI for their own deals (proposals, budgetary pricing, RFP inputs). Gather structured partner feedback and verify partner-modeled projects as real commercial pipeline.

User engagement & growth (~35%) Own activation and retention of the existing user base: guided first-project onboarding, re-engagement campaigns, and targeted newsletters.

Create technical content — case studies and “how to model X in EASI” walkthroughs (resiliency, bridging power, flexible interconnection) — for LinkedIn, Reddit developer communities, and the blog. Run outbound experiments (cold email/calls to target segments) and identify high-fit events for demos.

Monitor product analytics (MixPanel) to spot stuck users, feature gaps, and conversion candidates. Product management (~25%) Turn user research and partner feedback into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmap input. Drive go-to-market for new EASI features: release messaging, documentation, training material, and demo scripts.

Maintain competitive awareness of adjacent modeling tools (HOMER, Xendee, Energy Toolbase, etc.) and how EASI wins.

Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in an energy-related field — electrical/mechanical engineering, physics, energy systems, or similar (or equivalent experience). 0–3 years of post-grad experience in energy, cleantech, consulting, or B2B software. Strong recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

Hands-on exposure to energy modeling tools — e.g. HOMER, Energy Toolbase, Xendee, PVsyst, HelioScope, or REopt — from coursework, research, or work. Excellent communicator — able to explain a techno-economic model to an engineer and its business value to an executive, in writing and live.

Self-directed operator — comfortable owning a number (activation, partner signups) and figuring out how to move it in a startup environment. Able to travel up to 25% for conferences, partner demos, and team onsites.

Preferred Qualifications: Understanding of microgrids, DERs, solar + storage economics, or utility planning and interconnection processes. Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot), product analytics (MixPanel), or content creation for technical audiences. Prior demo, sales engineering, applications engineering, or customer success exposure.

Experience selling to or working with utilities, co-ops, ESCOs, or EPCs. Based in California — Northern California or a West Coast hub is ideal for partner visits and events. Salary: $75,000 - $95,000 Originally posted on Himalayas

Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.

Worum es geht
Unsere Produkte sind gefragt. Du baust ein paselo Expertennetzwerk auf, die unsere Produkte empfehlen, wenn sie überzeugt sind.
Damit eins klar ist: Am Anfang ist das zu 70 % Telefon. Du recherchierst, du rufst an, du sprichst mit Menschen, die dich nicht erwartet haben. Du wirst öfter ein Nein hören als ein Ja. Wenn dich das abschreckt, ist die Rolle nichts für dich. Wenn dich das reizt, weil du weißt, dass genau hier der Unterschied entsteht.
Aufgaben
Ownership statt Zuarbeit. Das Partnerprogramm ist deins – von der Zielgruppen-Definition über die Ansprache bis zur Betreuung der ersten Partner. Du bist nicht die Verstärkung für ein bestehendes Team. Du bist das Team.
Kaltakquise am Telefon. Du erklärst in 30 Sekunden, warum sich das Gespräch für sie lohnt. Du gehst mit einem konkreten nächsten Schritt raus, nicht mit einem „Schicken Sie mir mal was".
Pipeline bauen und pflegen. Du recherchierst Leads, qualifizierst sie und hältst nach.
Das Angebot schärfen. Nach 50 Gesprächen weißt du besser als wir, welcher Einwand immer kommt und welches Argument zieht. Du bringst das zurück ins Unternehmen, und wir ändern das Angebot.
Partner aktivieren. Ein unterschriebener Partner, der nichts empfiehlt, ist kein Partner. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Zusagen Umsatz wird.
Zahlen im Blick. Kontaktierte Personen, Gesprächsquote, Abschlüsse, Umsatz pro Partner. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit, bevor wir danach fragen.
Qualifikation
Eingeschriebener Student. Fachrichtung egal. BWL hilft nicht mehr als Tiermedizin oder Germanistik.
Du telefonierst gerne – und zwar wirklich.
Frustrationstoleranz. Zwanzig Absagen bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du analysierst, was schiefgelaufen ist, und wählst die nächste Nummer.
Sehr gutes Deutsch am Telefon. Du sprichst klar, freundlich und auf Augenhöhe – mit Personen, die dreimal so alt sind wie du und wenig Zeit haben.
Struktur. Du arbeitest mit CRM und Kalender, nicht mit Gedächtnis und Post-its. Bei 300 Kontakten funktioniert Improvisation nicht mehr.

Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung. Fixum plus Provision. Wer abliefert, verdient deutlich über Werkstudenten-Niveau.
Echte Eigenverantwortung. Der Aufbau eines Vertriebskanals von null – nicht die Assistenz beim Aufbau.
Direkter Zugang zum Founder. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Abstimmungs-Pingpong.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence—combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights—seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.
Over the past decade, Everlywell has delivered close to 1 billion personalized health insights, transforming care for 60 million people and powering hundreds of enterprise partners. In 2025, an estimated 1 in 94 U.S. adults received an Everlywell test, solidifying our spot as the #1 at-home testing company in the country.

Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.
About DxS
DxS is Everlywell ’s diagnostics services business that powers diagnostics‑driven programs for external partners. We work with diagnostic laboratories, telehealth and digital health platforms, life sciences and biopharma companies, and other enterprise clients to design and operate programs that use Everlywell ’s clinical, operational, and technology infrastructure.
Our ambition is to make Everlywell the go‑to commercialization and clinical operations partner for advanced diagnostics—helping innovators bring new tests to market, integrate telehealth and clinical services, and scale high‑quality programs across thousands of patients and multiple channels.

We are hiring a VP, Sales & Business Development – Diagnostic & Telehealth Services (DxS) to lead the B2B2C commercial motion for Everlywell ’s diagnostics services portfolio.
You will build and manage a proactive pipeline of consumer‑facing diagnostics brands, DTC digital-health companies, genetics companies with a consumer offering, virtual care providers, and innovative labs that can leverage Everlywell ’s infrastructure to launch and scale diagnostics‑driven programs.

Rather than selling standalone tests, you will sell the clinical infrastructure underpinning programs across diagnostics, virtual care, logistics/operations, and reporting into partner‑branded or white‑label experiences.
You will own the full DxS sales lifecycle—from prospecting and discovery through solution design, commercial modeling, contracting, and handoff to implementation—while partnering closely with Clinical Operations, Product, Finance, and Marketing to shape offerings and ensure programs are set up to scale. This is both a strategic and tactical role: you will help define the future of the DxS business while also carrying a quota and closing net‑new, multi‑stakeholder deals .

Own the DxS B2B2C new‑business pipeline for diagnostics, genetics, and enterprise programs—from prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and close.
Lead discovery and program design with prospective clients, translating their needs into clear DxS proposals, pricing, and statements of work that bundle diagnostics, virtual care, logistics/ops, and reporting.
Partner with Finance, Product, and Clinical Operations to structure deals that meet Everlywell ’s revenue, margin, and scalability targets, including consumer utilization and funnel assumptions.
Own DxS commercial contracting in partnership with Legal, including negotiating terms, aligning on scope, and ensuring operational readiness before signature.
Build and maintain executive‑level relationships with key client stakeholders (commercial, clinical, operations, finance) to drive adoption, expansion, and long‑term partnerships.
Develop and maintain an accurate DxS pipeline; forecast monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue and report performance and insights to executive leadership.
Represent the company and expand the pipeline by attending key conferences, seminars, webinars, and other external‑facing events.
Collaborate with Marketing to refine DxS positioning and build compelling pitch materials (decks, proposals, case studies) that clearly articulate our value proposition to telehealth and digital health partners.
Serve as the voice of the market for DxS, feeding structured insights back into product, pricing, and go‑to‑market strategy for telehealth and digital health use cases.

Telehealth / digital health / B2B2C experience
5-10 years in enterprise sales or business development in telehealth, digital health, consumer diagnostics, or adjacent health tech, with a strong track record of closing complex, multi‑stakeholder deals.
Direct experience selling B2B2C or platform programs through partners (e.g., telehealth platforms, virtual primary care, digital health brands, employers, payers, retailers)—not just hospital/IDN lab contracts.
Comfortable talking about consumer funnels, activation, utilization, and unit economics , not just test volume.
Quota‑carrying seller and builder
Demonstrated history of owning a personal annual quota (e.g., $5–20M+) and consistently meeting or exceeding targets.
Clear track record of net‑new logo acquisition and expansion, not just renewals or “relationship management.”
Has led multi‑month, multi‑stakeholder sales cycles i nvolving product, operations, clinical, legal, and finance on both sides.
Program & platform mindset
Experience designing or selling integrated programs that bundle diagnostics, virtual care, logistics/ops, and reporting into a cohesive offering.
Partners naturally with product and operations on offer structure (tiers, bundles, workflows), pricing & margins , and implementation/performance management.
Stage and Operating style
Experience at growth‑stage health tech or diagnostics (Seed–Series E / PE roll‑up), not only large legacy incumbents.
Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment and is comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands‑on execution.
Understanding and use of AI in daily work to accelerate client research, value proposition tailoring, and opportunity identification.

Wer wir sind
Octopus Energy ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Energieunternehmen Europas. In Deutschland versorgen wir über eine Million Kunden mit günstiger, grüner Energie und wachsen weiter. Wir denken Energie neu: tech-driven, kundenzentriert, agil. Unser Team in Deutschland arbeitet mit der Geschwindigkeit eines Scale-ups und der Ambition, den deutschen Energiemarkt grundlegend zu verändern.
Die Rolle
Wir bündeln unsere kommerziellen Bereiche unter einer Führung, um die nächste Wachstumsphase zu treiben. Als Commercial Director verantwortest du unsere gesamte kommerzielle Strategie, von Vertriebskanälen über Kundenbindung bis hin zu Produktentwicklung und Partnerschaften. Du bist Teil unseres Senior Management Teams und arbeitest direkt mit CEO und CFO an der strategischen Steuerung des Unternehmens.
Deine Verantwortung
Commercial Strategy & Performance
Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer kohärenten Commercial-Strategie über alle Vertriebskanäle hinweg: Field Sales, Online/Direct, Preisvergleichsportale und Partnerschaften
Ownership der zentralen Unit Economics und Kanal-Profitabilität – mit dem Ziel, den optimalen Kanal-Mix kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Pricing, Marketing und Produkt über Matrixstrukturen – du steuerst die kommerziellen KPIs bereichsübergreifend
Woche für Woche Anpassung der Strategie auf Basis von Marktdynamiken, Wettbewerbsbewegungen und Kundenverhalten
Kundenbindung & Customer Lifetime Value
Ownership der Retention-Strategie: Kohortenanalysen, Preissensitivität, Angebotsgestaltung und optimales Timing
Fachliche Steuerung der Retention-Aktivitäten in Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing (Lifecycle-Kommunikation) und Pricing
Vorantreiben der Automatisierung und Skalierung von Kundenbindungsprozessen auf unserer Technologieplattform
Produkte, Innovation & Skalierung
Kommerzielle Bewertung und Skalierung neuer Produkte und Tarife – mit dem Blick auf Unit Economics, Product-Market Fit und Skalierbarkeit
Steuerung des Weges vom Pilotprojekt zum skalierbaren Produkt – mit unternehmerischem Urteilsvermögen, nicht nur Projektmanagement
Entwicklung von Cross-Selling- und Bundling-Strategien über unsere Geschäftsbereiche (energy retail, flexibility, low carbon tech, mobility) hinweg
Vertrieb & Partnerschaften
Direkte Führungsverantwortung für Vertriebsteams und das Partnerships-Team – Fokus auf Produktivität, Effizienz und Wachstum
Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsplattform-Strategie
Aufbau und Management strategischer Partnerschaften mit Marktpartnern und Plattformen
Führung & Zusammenarbeit
Teil des Senior Management Teams, gemeinsam mit CEO, CFO und den Directors für Tech, Marketing, Operations und People
Führung mehrerer Teams mit direkter und indirekter Verantwortung über Matrixstrukturen
Enger Austausch mit dem globalen Octopus-Netzwerk für Best Practices und gemeinsame Initiativen
Dein Profil
8–12 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon signifikante Zeit in einer Scale-up-Umgebung mit B2C-Fokus – z.B. Telko, Fintech, Insurance, Subscription-Modelle oder vergleichbare Märkte
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer Querschnittsrolle mit P&L-Verantwortung über mehrere Bereiche – du hast bewiesen, dass du viele Themen parallel treiben kannst
Datengetrieben, aber nicht datenabhängig: Du verstehst Analytics als Steuerungstool, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst idealerweise auch selbst in Daten eintauchen – triffst aber genauso Entscheidungen, wenn die Datenlage nicht perfekt ist
Unternehmerisches Mindset: Du siehst Opportunitäten, bewertest sie schnell und setzt in Eigenverantwortung um – ohne auf eindeutige Arbeitsanweisungen zu warten
Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist bereit, operativ tief einzusteigen, und entwickelst gleichzeitig die übergreifende Strategie
Erfahrung in der Führung über Matrixstrukturen – du mobilisierst Teams auch dort, wo du nicht disziplinarisch führst
Hohe Ambiguitätstoleranz: Du triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit und priorisierst sicher in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld
Fließend Deutsch und Englisch
Wichtiger als Branchenwissen: Wir suchen keine Energieexperten, sondern kommerzielle Exzellenz. Wer ein analytisches Gehirn mit Drive und Kreativität verbindet und in komplexen, dynamischen Umgebungen zu Hause ist, bringt das Wichtigste mit. Fachtiefe im Energiemarkt lässt sich zügig aufbauen.
Was wir bieten
Gestaltungsfreiheit: Du definierst die kommerzielle Strategie eines der innovativsten Energieversorger Europas – und setzt sie um.
Impact: Direkte Auswirkung auf über eine Million Kunden und die Profitabilität des gesamten Unternehmens.
Team: Ein Senior Management Team, das auf Augenhöhe arbeitet, schnell entscheidet und liefert.
Wachstum: Ein Unternehmen, das sich Woche für Woche weiterentwickelt – Langeweile ausgeschlossen.
Vergütung: Wettbewerbsfähiges Paket auf Director-Level.
Kein Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und sag uns in wenigen Sätzen, warum genau diese Rolle dich reizt.

About MedTech World
Launched in 2020, MedTech World began as a bold initiative to position Malta as a bridge connecting startups, investors, service providers, and thought leaders across the Medical and HealthTech space. Five years on, we have grown into a genuinely global platform with operations spanning Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia.
We now run four summits, across four continents, in four quarters. Each event brings together the most important voices in MedTech and HealthTech to move the industry forward, and we are growing fast.
To drive our North American growth, we are looking for a commercially experienced, well-connected, and self-driven sales professional who can open doors, close deals, and work hand-in-hand with our wider team to build something exceptional.

As Senior Sales and Partnerships Manager, North America, you will be a key commercial driver across the US and Canadian markets. This is a hands-on role built for someone who brings real experience, knows how to operate independently, and is ready to take genuine ownership of a region.
You will be generating pipeline, closing sponsors and partners, and working closely with the CEO and the wider sales and partnerships team. Your work will have a direct and visible impact on the business from day one.
Remote. Open to candidates across the US and Canada, provided they are eligible to work in their country of residence.

Drive revenue across MedTech World's sponsorship, exhibition, and partnership offerings for the US and Canadian markets, covering all four annual summits.
Build and manage a strong pipeline of sponsors, institutional partners, hospital systems, government bodies, and corporate exhibitors from within the North American MedTech and HealthTech ecosystem.
Lead the full sales cycle independently, from prospecting and outreach through to proposal, negotiation, and close.
Develop tailored commercial proposals that match sponsor and partner objectives to MedTech World's event portfolio.
Represent MedTech World at industry events, conferences, and networking forums across North America to build brand presence and generate leads.
Work closely with the partnerships and marketing teams to ensure a seamless experience for sponsors and partners before, during, and after each event.
Provide regular pipeline reports, revenue forecasts, and market intelligence to the leadership team.
Identify and pursue new commercial opportunities across the region, including health system innovation arms, venture funds, accelerators, trade associations, and federal and state government bodies.
What You Will Bring
Proven track record in senior sales or business development within the events, MedTech, HealthTech, or life sciences sectors.
A strong existing network across the US and Canadian MedTech, HealthTech, or healthcare innovation ecosystem that you can activate from day one.
The ability to work independently without day-to-day direction, while remaining a strong and collaborative team player.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing high-value commercial agreements.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Comfort operating across multiple time zones and markets simultaneously.
Willingness to travel across North America and internationally for events and client meetings.
Experience with CRM platforms and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

s.h: You Will Thrive in This Role If You Are
s.t:
Commercially sharp, with a proven instinct for identifying opportunities, building pipeline, and closing deals without needing direction.
A natural relationship builder, someone who genuinely enjoys the process of earning trust with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and partners over time.
A confident and credible communicator, comfortable representing MedTech World in rooms with C-suite executives, investors, hospital leaders, and government bodies.
Proactive and self-directed, you spot commercial opportunities before they are pointed out and move on them quickly.
Energized by the MedTech and HealthTech space, whether through prior experience or a genuine passion for where healthcare and innovation meet.
Comfortable with variety and pace, no two weeks look the same across four summits, four continents, and a fast-moving team.
Ambitious, you want to grow into a VP of Sales or Chief Commercial Officer role as MedTech World scales, and you see this as the platform to get there.
A background in MedTech, HealthTech, life sciences, events, or B2B sales within a high-growth environment is a strong advantage. That said, a strong existing network, commercial instinct, and the drive to build something matter more than any single credential.
This role is not the right fit if you are looking for a structured corporate sales environment with long approval chains, prefer inbound-only pipeline, or are not comfortable working autonomously across multiple markets simultaneously.
What Success Looks Like?
The North American market is a consistent and growing revenue contributor across all four MedTech World summits, with a strong pipeline of sponsors, partners, and exhibitors closing quarter on quarter.
Key relationships across the US and Canadian MedTech, HealthTech, investor, and institutional ecosystem are owned and deepened, with MedTech World recognised as the go-to platform for the region.
The CEO and leadership team have full visibility across North American pipeline, forecasts, and deal progress without needing to chase updates.
Sponsors and partners secured through North America are returning year on year, with satisfaction and renewal rates that reflect a high-quality commercial relationship.
You have built trust, expanded your scope, and are on a clear path toward VP of Sales or Chief Commercial Officer as MedTech World scales.

This role is intentionally designed as a launchpad. High performers will be considered for progression into a VP of Sales or Chief Commercial Officer position as MedTech World continues to scale globally. You will earn real commercial ownership quickly, expanding your scope across markets, summits, and revenue lines alongside the business.
Ready to help shape healthcare?
If you are driven by impact, excited by international travel, and ready to take your commercial career to another level, we would love to meet you.
Apply now and help bring the MedTech World vision to life across North America.

German SMEs carry an unavoidable administrative load: bookkeeping, monthly VAT returns, annual accounts. Work that must happen, that nobody wants to do, and that has stayed far too expensive.
mika takes it over. Because compliance is mandatory rather than optional, what we are building is infrastructure, and the purpose is to reduce the cost of doing business in Germany.
We went from 100 to over 700 customers in eight months and remain a small team. Roles here are therefore wide: you own an area rather than a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people to build it, and your scope grows as you do. We work in English, the team is international, the market is German.
Tasks
Partner and referral leads arrive already trusting us, which is the hardest part of our sale to manufacture any other way. We have only recently started testing this properly and it is already carrying a meaningful share of new pipeline. The pieces exist and nobody holds them together.
Networker and closer, in one person. Partnerships attracts people who are wonderful in a room, know everybody, and never sign anything. It also attracts people who can close but cannot keep a relationship alive past the signature. We need both halves.
And we need somebody who knows that a partnership is more than paying someone to send us customers. The ones that last are built on something both sides actually want: a better answer for their own customers, a gap in their offering closed, a reason for them to look good. If your instinct is to open with a commission rate, this is not the role.
You build the channel across referral and integration partners and the programmes around them, and you shape where it goes beyond that. We will talk about the specifics in the process.

Own the channel and its number end to end
Close. Take partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including the commercial negotiation.
Structure the deals yourself. Work out what the partner gets, at which price tier, on the subscription or on the one-off revenue or both, over what period. You should know our unit economics well enough to say no without asking.
Own what happens after signature: technical handover, partner onboarding, and the routing rule agreed with the sales lead
Own the affiliate programme and our comparison-page strategy, working with our creative lead on production
Own our presence at events and conferences, where a surprising share of partnerships actually start
Prepare joint marketing with existing partners: webinars, co-branded content, campaigns
Apply our values filter honestly. Not every partner who would send us volume is one we want, and we would rather you turned one down than explained it afterwards.

s.h: what you bring to the table
s.t:
AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human.
You have closed partnership deals yourself , negotiated the terms, and can name what they produced afterwards
Ideally a real network in the German SME and entrepreneurship world, or in fintech.
You are commercially fluent. Revenue share, referral fees, attribution windows, exclusivity, minimum commitments: you model a deal and defend the structure.
You understand a business well enough to build the case from the partner's side rather than pitching at them
You follow up relentlessly and you keep partners warm after launch, which is where most partnerships quietly die
You are organised enough to run many parallel conversations without letting any of them go cold
the level we are hiring at
If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves. As the team grows, the path from here leads to Head of Partnerships.
We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and it is what lets one person hold more live conversations at once than this job would otherwise allow.

German fintech or banking ecosystem
Platform and marketplace partnerships
Comfortable in a technical scoping conversation, enough to know what is easy and what is not
Affiliate and influencer programmes
API integrations and partner onboarding flows
Event and conference experience
German at C1 or above is preferred. The ecosystem we are building in is German and so are most of the negotiations. For an exceptional candidate we would work with English alone, so if the rest fits, apply anyway. English at B2 or above in either case, since it is our working language.

Base 60,000 to 80,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component tied to activated partners and partner-sourced revenue rather than to pipeline volume, plus stock options. On-target earnings 75,000 to 100,000 EUR.
Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.
why mika?
A channel with no incumbent owner , so its shape is your call.
Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for.
Deals you structure yourself , rather than terms handed to you
Founders in the detail with you , and no layer between you and a decision
A category nobody has built. German business owners do not know an alternative to their tax advisor exists, which is also why the right partner is worth so much to us.
Work that matters outside the building. Every customer a partner sends us gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.
Send us your CV and one partnership you closed: how the deal was structured, what it produced, and what nearly killed it.

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !
Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez Pennylane ?
L’ANECS et le CJEC réunissent une génération qui contribue déjà à façonner le cabinet de demain : collaborateurs en cabinet, stagiaires experts-comptables, mémorialistes, jeunes diplômés, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes experts-comptables installés.
Tous ne créeront pas leur cabinet. Beaucoup évolueront au sein de structures existantes et participeront directement à leur transformation : nouvelles pratiques de production, développement de nouvelles missions, adoption de l’IA, structuration commerciale, attractivité des équipes et amélioration de la productivité.
Pour les membres en phase d’installation, de reprise ou déjà installés, les enjeux sont très concrets : choisir les bons outils, développer leur activité, structurer les équipes et les missions, gagner en efficacité et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Pennylane a un rôle à jouer au-delà de celui d’un simple éditeur : devenir un partenaire de développement business et de productivité pour les cabinets qui se créent, se transforment et grandissent.
L’ANECS et le CJEC constituent un écosystème national et régional dense, avec près de 50 sections. Les bureaux se renouvellent en alternance, une année sur deux, ce qui demande une animation relationnelle continue et une transmission structurée entre les équipes sortantes et entrantes.

construire une préférence durable pour Pennylane auprès de la nouvelle génération de la profession comptable ;
accompagner les membres dans leurs enjeux de carrière, de développement de cabinet et de transformation des pratiques ;
transformer les partenariats, événements et prises de parole en contacts qualifiés, signaux d’intention et opportunités ;
sécuriser une relation continue avec les instances nationales et les sections régionales ;
faire de Pennylane un partenaire reconnu pour développer le business et la productivité des cabinets.
Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?
Tu construis et animes la relation entre Pennylane et l’écosystème ANECS-CJEC. Ta mission est de faire de Pennylane un partenaire de référence pour celles et ceux qui font évoluer la profession comptable : futurs experts-comptables, collaborateurs en cabinet, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes installés.
Tu combines une forte présence terrain, l’animation d’une communauté active, la construction de contenus utiles et un travail étroit avec l’équipe commerciale. Tu développes une connaissance fine des membres, de leurs parcours et de leurs besoins afin d’identifier les moments pertinents pour activer Pennylane : évolution professionnelle, projet d’installation, reprise, recrutement, développement de nouvelles missions ou besoin de gagner en productivité.
Tu pilotes la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC, animes le réseau des sections régionales et assures la continuité de la relation lors du renouvellement alterné des bureaux.
Tu conçois et portes les activations les plus pertinentes : événements, ateliers, contenus, formats communautaires et prises de parole.
En lien étroit avec l’équipe commerciale, tu contribues aux initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets. Tu développes une communauté qualifiée, identifies les signaux d’intention et assures la bonne transmission des opportunités aux équipes commerciales, au bon moment dans le parcours de chaque contact.
Tu seras rattaché·e à Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable, et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.
Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?
Pilotage du partenariat national — 20 %
Porter la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC de bout en bout : convention annuelle, gouvernance, budget, négociation des contreparties et plan d’activation.
Gérer le budget sponsoring et événementiel, estimé à environ35 k€ par an, et en suivre le retour sur investissement.
Sécuriser puis activer les contreparties les plus utiles : visibilité, contenus, prises de parole, accès aux sections, formats exclusifs et opportunités de qualification.
Construire une relation de confiance avec les instances nationales et assurer la continuité du partenariat dans la durée.
Animation du réseau et présence terrain — 30 %
Animer la communauté ANECS-CJEC au niveau national et régional, avec une présence régulière auprès des sections, de leurs bureaux et de leurs membres.
Maintenir un mapping fiable des élus, ambassadeurs et relais locaux ; préparer activement les passations entre bureaux sortants et entrants.
Construire et exécuter un plan de présence terrain ambitieux et priorisé : congrès, Estivales, DEC After, soirées jeunes inscrits, Olympiades, Journées des Jeunes Inscrits, tables rondes et événements locaux.
Concevoir des activations utiles et engageantes : ateliers, témoignages, formats de networking, démonstrations, échanges entre pairs et prises de parole.
Assurer le suivi post-événement : qualification des contacts, activation de la communauté, transmission des signaux pertinents aux équipes commerciales et partage des apprentissages terrain.

**About Verdancy
**Verdancy is a start up in the making from the Schwaneberg Group at the Institute of Biotechnology of RWTH Aachen University. It develops biodegradable additives that make crop-protection products stick to leaves and last longer.

Bio-based microgels carry the active substance and release it on demand, while bi-adhesive peptides anchor the microgel to the leaf wax so the coating survives rain — meaning fewer sprays and less pesticide lost to the environment.

A second product line uses bifunctional peptides (antimicrobial peptide + anchor) as peptide-based pesticides in their own right, protected by patent EP3261435B1.

The entry market is copper fungicide against grapevine downy mildew, where there is no real alternative today, poor rain resistance is a known problem, and the EU is pushing hard to cut copper use.
**The opportunity
**Built on more than 10 years of university research across six projects (€7m raised, TRL 5), the startup is now being further developed by Susanne Braun (CSO, polymer chemist, carrier systems and formulations) and Atul Kumar (CTO, biotechnologist, protein engineering).

Verdancy already has a developed business model, funding secured through May 2027 via the Warp Speed Fund of the Materials Lab Incubator (MerLIn), a successful soybean-rust project and a new €2.4m insect-focused project starting January 2027.

What's missing is the business development leadership to found the spin-off company and go after an €80B addressable market (€1.2B in the copper segment alone).
